answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Work waits on the vault until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the anchor of the next round. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, capped per identity per epoch, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Reaching the echo of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
